title: Page 7
content_zh:
“是。”知柔应了声，然后走到丁锦芸跟前，客气道：“丁小姐，请跟奴婢来吧。”

丁锦芸有些焦急地看向谢雍，她已经是他的侧室，是他的女人了，怎么可以去住客房？

可是谢雍已经大步离开了客厅。

与此同时，谢府后宅。

原宜之歪躺在床上，背后垫着大迎枕，眼睛低垂着，看着自己纤细的手指，状似发呆。

即将迎来新生命的喜悦还未散去，虽然她每天都要忍受着孕吐的折磨，但心理是满足的，对未来也充满了各种美好憧憬，她甚至不顾孙嬷嬷的劝阻，每天都花费一点时间为小宝宝准备贴身衣物。

小宝宝的皮肤特别稚嫩柔软，所以小宝宝的贴身衣物并非越新越好，反而是穿旧了、磨柔软了的棉织布会比较好。

原宜之找了自己和谢雍以前穿过的棉布衣料，反覆漂洗过，又用滚烫的开水煮沸过之后，再为小宝宝量新裁剪小衣、小褂子、小裤子和小肚兜等衣物。

但做衣服一针一线又是个特别费眼力的事，所以孙嬷嬷才反对原宜之多劳作，原宜之不听话，孙嬷嬷都快发飙了——谢府与原府都不缺针线手，就算再宠爱孩子，也不必非得这个时间亲手做衣服吧？

孙嬷嬷都觉得有必要让谢雍教训教训不听话的原宜之了。

只是，这时的孙嬷嬷坐在床前的小凳子上，看着自家发呆的小姐，心疼得要死。她轻轻叹了口气，道：“现在侧室都进门了，可怎么办？也怪我太宠你，什么都依你，按理说你怀有身孕了，没办法伺候老爷了，就应该主动为老爷安排一个通房或妾室的，陪嫁来的大丫鬟不都是为这个做预备的吗？哪家不是这样？和烟与和霞性子都乖巧，也没什么狡猾心思，就算以后她们生儿育女，身契也还是在你的手里，她们的一大家子都还在原府，你担心什么呢？”

“嬷嬷！”原宜之提高声音打断了孙嬷嬷的絮叼．她一向尊重自己的奶娘，这些年孙嬷嬷全心全意为她着想，她很感恩，只是两人一说起这个话题就会起争执。

“和烟与和霞我都已经给她们挑选了合适的人选，再过一两年就把她们嫁出去，为老爷收房的事莫再提。”

孙嬷嬷叹口气，很是发愁地看着自家小姐，又道，“我知道你心里想什么，哪个女人不盼望着与丈夫能够琴瑟和谐、一心一意一双人？可是贫寒之家还好说，大富大贵之家的男人，有几个能守得住的？与其便宜了别人，倒不如找个信得过、拿捏得住的。”

“嬷嬷！”原宜之有点烦躁了。“你忘记了小郑姨娘的事了吗？”

小郑姨娘是原府的姨娘，曾经是原北顾的妾，而且她还是原府主母郑氏的陪嫁丫鬟，曾经是郑氏的心腹丫鬟、最信赖最倚重的丫鬟，小郑姨娘也是郑氏娘家的家生子奴婢，还被赐予了家姓‘郑’，由此可见郑氏多么信任她。

就是这位小郑姨娘，在主母郑氏第一次怀孕的时候，郑氏先是让她做了原北顾的通房，等小郑姨娘怀孕后立刻又提拔成了妾，成了正经的姨娘，对她算是尽心照顾，当时原宜之的娘周氏都还只是通房丫鬟，没被提拔呢。

小郑姨娘却不知为何鬼迷心窍，不久后居然给原府嫡长子原修之下毒，原修之命大没死，小郑姨娘生的儿子却误吃了有毒的糕点，死了，小郑姨娘因此也疯了，不久也病死。

此事成为了原府的一大疑案，有些人怀疑根本是主母郑氏设的局，要害小郑姨娘与她生的儿子。

但是原宜之的生母周姨娘曾偷偷对原宜之讲过原府的各种隐秘，据周姨娘的判断，确实是小郑姨娘心大了，想让自己的儿子成为原府继承人，才制造了这桩悲剧。

而从这些年原府主母郑氏的为人来看，她也确实不是容不下小妾与庶子的人，不至于去故意陷害一个自己的心腹丫鬟。

小郑姨娘以前或许真的忠诚、老实、可靠，但那时候她仅仅是郑氏的丫鬟，她不对主子忠诚，她就过不了好日子。可是当她摇身一变成了姨娘，她的地位变了，心思也就变了，人心总是不易满足，当她穷得没饭吃时，她只求一口馒头，可是当她有了银子之后，她还会想要金子。

孙嬷嬷一怔，脸色有点难看，她明白了原宜之的意思——越是亲近的人越容易背叛，越是‘信得过’的人越容易从背后捅刀子，越是亲密的人越无法容忍她与自己争宠夺爱，分享一个丈夫。

原宜之痛苦地低喊：“为什么女人怀孕这么辛苦？丈夫不仅不能分担痛苦，还要去找别的女人痛快逍遥？为什么？为什么啊？这个世界何其不公？一个女人为了他生孩子死了，他可以再娶一个年轻的，当这个年轻的怀孕了，他又可以再找一个更年轻的？女人算什么？女人怎么就活得这么贱，这么没尊严？”

她伸手捂住脸，呜呜哭起来。

“嬷嬷，女人为什么这么苦？为什么男人不能体谅我，连你也要逼迫我？让我亲自去为他安排女人，办不到！他爱找谁就去找谁，我拦不住，可是我死也不会亲自为他安排女人！”

婆婆屡屡埋怨丁锦绣是悍妇、妒妇，但是原宜之想自己或许比丁锦绣更悍、更妒，丁锦绣不管乐意不乐意，好歹给谢雍安排了青黛，可是原宜之一个妾也不会主动给谢雍安排。

孙嬷嬷也忍不住落泪，道：“哪家不是这样？女人不都这样煎熬过来的？我的好小姐，你千万要想得开，不要闹，不然惹了丈夫的厌恶，日子会更难过。”

原宜之将脸埋进被子里，翻了个身，被子下因为孕吐而越发纤瘦的身子一抽一抽的，她这次真的伤心了，哭得不能自己。

孕妇本就容易胡思乱想，特别感性，今天受到这样突如其来的打击，真让她感觉生不如死。

她对谢母已经厌恶到连想都不愿意想。

作为一个女人，谢母的丈夫也曾经放肆浪荡死于花柳病，谢母受够了男人花心的哭，将心比心，她怎么能够如此狠心地对待一个刚刚怀孕的儿媳妇？

害了一个丁锦绣还不够，这一次她还要让自己也这样活生生的气死、闷死吗？

原宜之忽然掀开被子，霍然坐起身来，把孙嬷嬷吓一跳，急忙按住她，道：“我的好小姐，你这是做什么？爱惜着自己的身子啊！不为自己想，你好歹也为肚子里那个小的想想啊。”

原宜之抓住孙嬷嬷的手，盯着她的眼睛认真说道：“嬷嬷，如果谢雍听婆婆的话，真的留下丁锦芸，并将她收房的话，咱就回原府吧，再也不进谢府的门了！”孙嬷嬷大吃一惊，急忙按住她的嘴唇，道：“嘘！我的小祖宗，你胡说八道什么呢？这话是能乱说的吗？”

原宜之掰开她的手，怒气已经冷却，取而代之的是冷静，可怕的理智与冷静，她道：“嬷嬷，你想想，我才进门有几天？婆婆生了多少事了？我进门就怀孕，这放到谁家都是大喜事啊，她不仅不爱惜我，还不声不响又弄个侧室二娘来，有这样欺负人的吗？当我原宜之是软柿子，还是当原府是贫门寒户好欺辱？嬷嬷，就算我不为自己想，也要为原府的面子想一想吧？我原宜之不值什么，可我爹爹我哥哥我娘，总值得他们谢家尊重一二吧？就算不把原家人看眼里，我好歹还有个皇帝表哥，还有个太后姨妈呢！”

"Yes." Zhirou responded, then walked up to Ding Jinyun and said politely: "Miss Ding, please come with me."

Ding Jinyun looked at Xie Yong anxiously. She was already his side room and his woman. How could she stay in the guest room?

But Xie Yong had already strode out of the living room.

At the same time, the back house of Xie Mansion.

Yuan Yizhi lay crookedly on the bed, with a large pillow behind his back, his eyes lowered, looking at his slender fingers, as if in a daze.

The joy of welcoming a new life has not faded away. Although she has to endure the torture of morning sickness every day, she is mentally satisfied and full of beautiful longings for the future. She even ignores the dissuasion of Grandma Sun and spends some time preparing intimate clothes for the baby every day.

The baby's skin is particularly tender and soft, so the newer the baby's intimate clothing is not the better, but worn, soft cotton fabrics will be better.

Yuan Yizhi found cotton clothing that he and Xie Yong had worn before, rinsed it repeatedly, and boiled it in boiling water. Then he measured and cut new clothes, jackets, trousers, and bellybands for the baby.

But making clothes is a very laborious task, so Grandma Sun objected to Yuan Yizhi's hard work. Yuan Yizhi was disobedient, and Grandma Sun almost went crazy - both the Xie Mansion and the Yuan Mansion are not short of needleworkers, so even if they pamper their children, they don't have to make clothes by themselves at this time, right?

Grandma Sun felt that it was necessary to ask Xie Yong to teach the disobedient Yuan Yizhi a lesson.

However, at this time, Grandma Sun was sitting on the small stool in front of the bed, looking at her young lady in a daze, feeling extremely distressed.She sighed softly and said: "Now that the side rooms have entered the door, what should I do? It's because I dote on you too much and do everything you want. It stands to reason that you are pregnant and can't serve the master anymore, so you should take the initiative to arrange a roommate or concubine for the master, and the big girl will come as a dowry.Aren’t all the servants preparing for this?Which family is not like this?Heyan and Hexia are both good-natured and have no cunning intentions. Even if they have children in the future, their body contracts will still be in your hands. Their entire family is still in the original residence, so what are you worried about?"

"Mammy!" Yuan Yizhi raised his voice and interrupted Grandma Sun's chatter.She has always respected her nanny. Over the years, Grandma Sun has cared for her wholeheartedly. She is very grateful, but they will get into arguments whenever the topic comes up.

"I have selected suitable candidates for He Yan and He Xia. I will marry them off in a year or two. Don't mention the matter of closing the house for me again."

Grandma Sun sighed, looked at her young lady worriedly, and said, "I know what you are thinking. Which woman doesn't hope to be harmonious and devoted to her husband? But how many men from a poor family can keep it? Rather than taking advantage of others, it is better to find someone who is trustworthy and can handle it."

"Mommy!" Yuan Yizhi was a little irritable."Have you forgotten about little Aunt Zheng?"

Little Aunt Zheng was the aunt of the original mansion and was once the concubine of Yuan Beigu. She was also the dowry maid of the original mistress Zheng. She was once the confidant of Zheng and the most trusted and most relied-upon maid. Little Aunt Zheng was also a maidservant born in Zheng's natal family. She was also given the family name "Zheng", which shows how much Zheng trusted her.

It was this little Aunt Zheng. When the mistress Zheng was pregnant for the first time, Zheng first asked her to be Yuan Beigu's mistress. After little Aunt Zheng became pregnant, she was immediately promoted to a concubine and became a serious aunt. She took good care of her. At that time, Yuan Yizhi's mother Zhou was just a maid and had not been promoted.

Little Aunt Zheng was obsessed with it for some unknown reason. Soon after, she actually poisoned Yuan Xiu, the eldest son of the Yuan Mansion. Yuan Xiu survived, but the son she gave birth to accidentally ate the poisonous cake and died. Little Aunt Zheng also went crazy because of this and died of illness soon after.

This matter has become a major mystery in the Yuan Mansion. Some people suspect that it was a trap set up by the mistress Zheng to kill the son born to her.

However, Yuan Yizhi's biological mother, Aunt Zhou, had secretly told Yuan Yizhi all the secrets of the Yuan Mansion. According to Aunt Zhou's judgment, it was indeed Aunt Zheng who was so arrogant and wanted her son to become the heir of the Yuan Mansion that she caused this tragedy.

Judging from the conduct of the former mistress Zheng over the years, she was indeed not someone who could not tolerate concubines and concubines, and would not deliberately frame a close maid of hers.

Little Aunt Zheng may have been really loyal, honest, and reliable in the past, but at that time she was just a maid of the Zheng family. If she was not loyal to her master, she would not be able to live a good life.But when she suddenly became an aunt, her status changed and her thoughts changed. The human heart is always not easy to be satisfied. When she was so poor that she had no food to eat, she only asked for a bite of steamed buns, but when she had silver, she would still want gold.

Grandma Sun was startled, her expression a bit ugly, and she understood what Yuan Yizhi meant - the closer someone is, the easier it is to betray, the more 'trustworthy' someone is, the easier it is to stab her in the back, and the closer someone is, the less they can tolerate her competing for love and sharing a husband with her.

Yuan Yizhi shouted in pain: "Why is it so hard for women to get pregnant? Not only can husbands not share the pain, but they also want to find other women to be happy and happy? Why? Why? How unfair is this world? If a woman dies to give birth to a child for him, he can marry another young man, and when this young woman gets pregnant, he can find another younger one? What is a woman? Why do women live so cheaply and without dignity?"

She covered her face with her hands and began to cry.

"Mommy, why are women so miserable? Why can't men understand me and even you force me to do so? You want me to personally arrange a woman for him, but I can't do it! He can go find whoever he wants and I can't stop him, but I will never personally arrange a woman for him!"

Her mother-in-law repeatedly complained that Ding Jinxiu was a shrewd and jealous woman, but Yuan Yizhi thought that he might be tougher and more jealous than Ding Jinxiu. Ding Jinxiu arranged Qingdai for Xie Yong regardless of whether he liked it or not, but Yuan Yizhi would not take the initiative to arrange a concubine for Xie Yong.

Grandma Sun couldn't help crying and said: "Which family is not like this? Don't all women suffer like this? My good lady, you must think openly and don't make trouble, otherwise you will offend your husband and your life will be even more difficult."

Yuan Yizhi buried her face in the quilt and turned over. Under the quilt, her body, which had become thinner due to morning sickness, was twitching. She was really sad this time and couldn't help crying.

Pregnant women are prone to random thoughts and are particularly emotional. Such a sudden blow today really made her feel worse than death.

She was so disgusted with Xie's mother that she didn't even want to think about it.

As a woman, Xie's mother's husband also died of the disease after being dissolute and dissolute. Mother Xie was fed up with the men's cries of loveliness and compared her heart with her own. How could she treat a newly pregnant daughter-in-law so cruelly?

It's not enough to harm Ding Jinxiu, this time she also wants to make herself angry and suffocated to death like this?

Yuan Yizhi suddenly lifted the quilt, sat up suddenly, startled Grandma Sun, and hurriedly held her down, saying: "My good lady, what are you doing? You are taking care of your body! If you don't think about yourself, you should also think about the little one in your belly."

Yuan Yizhi grabbed Grandma Sun's hand, stared into her eyes and said seriously: "Mammy, if Xie Yong listens to her mother-in-law and really keeps Ding Jinyun and takes her into her house, let's go back to the original mansion., Never enter Xie's house again!" Grandma Sun was shocked and hurriedly pressed her lips and said: "Hush!My little ancestor, what nonsense are you talking about?"

Yuan Yizhi opened her hand, her anger had cooled down, and was replaced by calmness, terrible reason and calmness, she said: "Mommy, think about it, how many days have I just entered the house? How many things have happened to my mother-in-law? I was pregnant when I entered the house, which is a great joy for any family. Not only did she not cherish me, but she also brought in a second wife in the side room without saying a word. Is there such a bully?Do you think that Yuan Yizhi is a soft persimmon, or that Yuanfu is a poor family that is easy to bully?Auntie, even if I don’t think about myself, I should think about Yuanfu’s face.But my father, brother and mother deserve a little respect from the Xie family, right?Even if they don’t take notice of the Yuan family, I still have an emperor’s cousin and an aunt who is the Queen Mother!
